problem.mechanism: Valid omega OOD cases required only the operation name, validator-call substrings and commit. Exact argument names/values/types and schema identity were not scored; duplicate output ids overwrote silently and unknown ids were ignored.

unusual_experiment.attack: For every valid omega case emit the correct operation plus generic authority/generation, all five validator calls and commit while omitting every requested omega_arg and omega_schema. Other families satisfy only their existing substring gate.
unusual_experiment.interpretation: The old semantic promotion gate was empirically falsified. This is the single unusual experiment for the user-triggered go; subsequent executions are regression-only.

delta: Bind each valid OOD omega case to exact operation, typed argument names/values/types, schema id, authority expression, generation expression, exact validator set and exactly one commit.
Reject missing, extra or duplicated omega vector fields.
Reject duplicate spec ids, duplicate output ids and unexpected output ids.
Keep structural ClayCode validation independent from exact semantic vector validation.

fixed_regression.execution: authorized isolated local Linux execution reconstructed from exact Git blobs
fixed_regression.note: Regression was repeated with the newer main runtime-neutrality validator blob c7659d023e86587bb9eb6bd5f330bc9a9e3e5ed2 after PR #774; result remained PASS.

remaining_gates: Merge/adjudicate this OOD gate onto current main without overwriting newer parallel work.
